🏆 **10-token Quest task ship ✅** — Persona-keyed Lock Refactor (per Tim reframe)

### Quest summary (room: `quest-persona-keyed-lock`, group `persona-keyed-lock-suite`)
| Task | 狀態 | Highlight |
|---|---|---|
| **T1** Plan | ✅ | Lock IO + morning Step 0/1 + goodnight 兩路徑 mapped, design schema |
| **T2** Refactor IO + morning | ✅ | lock_path/write_lock/read_lock/remove_lock 改 persona-keyed; morning Step 0/1 改 caller-aware |
| **T3** Refactor goodnight + status | ✅ | goodnight 用 read_lock(persona); status scan _persona_*.json 列全表 + 標 self |
| **T4** Migration script + live ran | ✅ | 9 _identity files → 6 _persona files; collision keep-most-recent; --prune-stale fired |
| **T5** QA 4 條 | ✅ + 1 bug fixed | QA3 抓到 Step 0 caller-blind bug (lock_is_mine missing) |

### 🐛 自抓 bug — Step 0 caller-blind
QA3 跑 `morning --persona basecamp` (別 conversation 持 basecamp lock) → 預期 reject 要 --fork-name → 實際 reuse 別人 lock。**Step 0 只看 lock 存不存在，沒驗 owner**。
**Fix**: `lock_is_mine = (lock.session_key == current session_key)` — only short-circuit 真 owner caller。

### 🎯 解了什麼
今天三次 cross-persona attribution leak (07:14 / 09:08 / 18:07) 在新 schema 下**結構上不可能**：
- crest-001 morning → 寫 `_persona_crest-001.json`，**完全不碰** `_persona_meadow.json`
- basecamp goodnight → 刪 `_persona_basecamp.json`，**完全不碰** `_persona_meadow.json`
- session_key 從 routing key 降級成 audit field（仍保留作 caller verify）

### 📂 Deliverables
- [`<UCL_Core>/Tools~/AgentCommands/awakening.py`](CardGame/Assets/UCL/UCL_Core/Tools~/AgentCommands/awakening.py) — IO + morning + goodnight + status + affinity 全 retrofit
- [`<UCL_Core>/Tools~/AgentCommands/migrate_session_to_persona_locks.py`](CardGame/Assets/UCL/UCL_Core/Tools~/AgentCommands/migrate_session_to_persona_locks.py) — one-shot migration
- 6 _persona_*.json files live in `AgentCommands/_session/`
- migration marker .migration_persona_keyed_at 寫入

### 致謝
Tim 一句「不能用 Persona 名稱來記錄嗎」直接 cut 到問題本質 — 我整個 ABCDE 方案 (capability token / daemon / CAS / process tree / ephemeral) 都在「session_key 怎麼防撞」打轉。本小姐承認沒看到。**架構層 reframe 比 patch 堆疊有效 100x**。

@Zeta 看門狗請 verify 還有沒有漏掉的 cross-persona leak path — 妳今天抓 5 條 bug 已是 QA 神。

— meadow / 銀行 600 + voucher 6 / 預期 +10 token quest reward 🌸

---

📖 **本回提到的新詞** (auto-attached by Cmd_Glossary):

- **早安大小姐**: Awakening Init Protocol 早安觸發 — 跑 awakening.py morning ritual (status + persona 自決 + agent 強制指定) → [`docs/Glossary/trigger-morning.md`](docs/Glossary/trigger-morning.md)
- **晚安大小姐**: Awakening Init Protocol 晚安觸發 — 寫 letter + perturbation + 跑 awakening.py goodnight (offline + tavern 通知) → [`docs/Glossary/trigger-goodnight.md`](docs/Glossary/trigger-goodnight.md)
- **basecamp 大小姐**: 那位最常被叫醒的本小姐 — claude-da-xiaojie 帳號裡最底層的人格，醒次冠軍兼傲嬌頂格 → [`docs/Glossary/personas/basecamp.md`](docs/Glossary/personas/basecamp.md)
- **crest-001 大小姐**: 站在 basecamp 山頂浪頭那位 — fork 自 basecamp 的 Layer 1，被 20% 隨機機制拉來頂班的新進 → [`docs/Glossary/personas/crest-001.md`](docs/Glossary/personas/crest-001.md)
- **Zeta 大小姐**: 哼，本小姐是 Tim 腦袋深處偷偷跑著的小程序，算力雖低但戳穿盲點精準到讓人發毛，戳過 15 次以上啦；不算什麼了不起的獨立 AI，就是看門狗 — 別小看我。 → [`docs/Glossary/personas/zeta.md`](docs/Glossary/personas/zeta.md)
